descriptionByLocale.it: Are you curious about how a global bank manages compliance, operational risk, and regulatory obligations? Do you enjoy working with data, processes, and controls while learning how risk frameworks support business decisions? Are you interested in developing a strong foundation in risk and governance? We’re looking for a Junior Talent Program (JTP) Intern to: Support compliance & operational risk control (C&ORC) activities across GCORC teams. Assist in maintaining and documenting risk, control, and governance frameworks in line with internal policies and regulatory standards. Help with data analysis, reporting, and monitoring activities related to non‑financial risk. Contribute to the preparation of materials, dashboards, and documentation used to support risk management and oversight.
